description: Canonical label contract shared by the web (JS) and TUI (Ruby) suites: the words both UIs put on the same event. One source of truth: edit this file to change either side's words and BOTH suites must still pass. A case with "expected" is the same on both sides; one with "ruby" / "js" pins where the two UIs differ on purpose (the line around the label is each UI's own: the TUI's "x>" rows, the web's bubbles). Ruby: spec/labels_matrix_spec.rb; JS: spec/web/public/labels_matrix.test.js.

cancel_reasons.note: The label a canceled turn's line ends with, in parentheses (Formatting#turn_canceled_line: "✕ turn canceled (label)"; timing.js cancelLineText: "✕ canceled (label)"); null: no parentheses.

client_labels.note: The label on a prompt by its sender's client_id prefix (Formatting#prompt_line "label> prompt"; turn_events.js clientLabel). No client_id: the TUI's history/own prompt shows user>, the web's own bubble has no label.

hook_notice_labels.note: Who a hook's notice is from (EventRenderer.hook_notice_line "label> text"; turn_events.js hookNoticeLabel, shown "label: text").

empty_retry_lines.note: The row a step gets when the loop asks again (Formatting#format_empty_retry_line; turn_events.js emptyRetryLine).

retry_lines.note: The live status while the provider is asked again (generation_retrying): Formatting#format_generation_retry_line; turn_events.js retryStatusLine. Both count the retry of all retries (1/3); the wording around it differs.

reminder_lines.note: The line for the reminders a turn got (Formatting#reminder_line; turn_events.js reminderText).

served_model.note: Whether the served model is another one than the name asked (ServedModel.differs?; format.js servedModelDiffers).
